title: The vertical shift is the midline
text: The vertical shift is the $$y-$$ value where the $$\sin$$ function is raised

title: Midline relation to max and min
text: The midline is the average of the maximum and minimum values

title: Find the midline
text: The maximum value is $$5$$ and the minimum value is $$1$$, so the midpoint is $$\frac{5+1}{2}=3$$
